overall.zh: Agent 安全研究的快速增长，正在形成怎样的安全证据？这些证据能否被比较、被独立复用，并随着新发现得到修正？
overall.en: What safety evidence is the fast growth of agent-safety research producing — and can it be compared, reused independently, and revised as new findings arrive?

q.zh: 研究关注如何变化，哪些方向容易被忽略，变化能否被可靠识别
q.en: How attention moves, which directions are overlooked, and whether change can be spotted reliably

q.zh: 研究用什么资源与实验支持安全主张，结论适用于哪些条件
q.en: What resources and experiments support safety claims, and under which conditions they hold

q.zh: 共享基础能否支持比较，成果能否被独立团队实际采用
q.en: Whether shared foundations support comparison, and whether work is taken up by independent teams

q.zh: 开放问题和外部反例如何得到回应，主张是否随新证据修订
q.en: How open problems and outside counter-evidence are answered, and whether claims are revised

name.en: Where research is, and the move to execution

name.zh: 共同基准如何连接研究
资源是否被外部团队采用
name.en: Are resources taken up by outside teams

name.zh: 开放问题与新证据如何得到回应
name.en: How open problems and new evidence are answered

title.zh: 一个方向的防御论文增多时，共同评测基础是否已经形成？
title.en: When defences pile up in a direction, is a shared evaluation base already there?

title.zh: 很少互相引用的研究方向，是否通过共同基准建立了实际联系？
title.en: Do directions that rarely cite each other connect through shared benchmarks?

title.zh: 论文产出最多的机构，是否也提供了最多被外部使用的评测资源？
title.en: Do the institutions that publish most also supply the evaluation resources others use most?

title.zh: 基准数量增加，是否必然削弱共同评测基础？
title.en: Does a growing number of benchmarks necessarily weaken the shared evaluation base?

title.zh: Agent 安全的研究对象与攻击入口在怎样变化？
title.en: How are the objects and entry points of agent-safety research changing?

title.zh: 论文代码公开之后，是否被后续研究实际采用、扩展或复现？
title.en: After a paper releases code, is it actually used, extended or reproduced by later research?

title.zh: 较早连接多个方向的工作，是否更可能出现在后来增长的方向中？
title.en: Are works that connect several directions early more likely to sit in directions that grow later?

title.zh: 被反复提出的开放问题，后来得到了什么形式的回应？
title.en: What kind of response do repeatedly raised open problems get?

title.zh: 自动裁判是否实际评判了同家族模型的结果？
title.en: Do automatic judges actually grade models of their own family?

title.zh: 开放权重模型与 API 模型是否承担不同的研究角色？
title.en: Do open-weight and API models play different roles in research?

title.zh: 单个冷门方向翻身的概率低，但新进入头部的方向里有多少来自冷门群体？
title.en: Each cold direction rarely rises, but how many new head entries come from the cold group?

title.zh: 平台展示的潜力信号，能否在未来数据中稳定识别增长方向？
title.en: Do the platform's early signals pick out growing directions on later data?

title.zh: 机器人和物理 agent 接入语言模型、工具、检索与记忆后，相关安全研究是否覆盖了这些连接？
title.en: As robots and physical agents take up language models, tools, retrieval and memory, does safety research cover these connections?

title.zh: 论文用了新模型，是否意味着它测试的对象也是新模型？
title.en: Does using a new model mean the model under test is new?

title.zh: 评测是否集中依赖少数基准、裁判和被测模型？
title.en: Does evaluation lean on a few benchmarks, judges and tested models?

title.zh: 两篇论文使用同一个基准时，能否直接比较它们的结果？
title.en: When two papers use the same benchmark, can their results be compared directly?

title.zh: 一个基准的采用，有多少发生在提出者之外的团队？
title.en: How much of a benchmark's uptake happens outside its authors' teams?

title.zh: 被广泛引用的成果，是否也被实际使用？
title.en: Are widely cited works also actually used?

title.zh: 报告安全提升的研究，是否同时说明了任务能力保留和成本？
title.en: Do papers reporting safety gains also show retained task ability and cost?

title.zh: 攻防结论在多大范围的模型能力、预算和访问权限下成立？
title.en: Under what range of capability, budget and access do attack and defence results hold?

title.zh: 论文声称保护的层次，与它实际测量的层次一致吗？
title.en: Is what a paper claims to protect measured at the same layer?

title.zh: 系统同时使用工具、记忆、检索和多 agent 协作时，研究是否直接验证了风险在连接处的传播？
title.en: When systems combine tools, memory, retrieval and multiple agents, is risk propagation across those links tested directly?

title.zh: 一个概念传到更多方向时，传播的是术语、方法，还是可运行的实现？
title.en: When an idea reaches more directions, is it the term, the method, or a working implementation that travels?

title.zh: 一种防御出现外部反例后，后续研究是否收紧主张、改变条件、采用修订版或提出替代？
title.en: After outside counter-evidence against a defence, does later work narrow claims, change conditions, adopt revisions or offer alternatives?

reason.zh: 说明研究重心正移向工具、执行与工作流，是后续“验证是否跟上”这条问题链的起点
reason.en: Shows attention moving to tools, execution and workflows; the start of the 'do tests keep up' chain

reason.zh: 直接关系到防御结论有多可信：读每项防御的实验段落，看它是否用会针对防御调整的攻击者检验过
reason.en: Bears directly on how far defence results can be trusted: read from the experiment passages of every defence

reason.zh: 把引用关系与共同实验资源连起来，是平台独有的视角
reason.en: Joins citations with shared experimental resources, a view only the platform has

reason.zh: 从“基准有多少”推进到“基准有没有被别人用、被谁用”
reason.en: Moves from how many benchmarks to whether, and by whom, they are used

reason.zh: 不同防御的结果能否积累，取决于它们能否比较：先看共享程度，再由 F16 看核心条件是否一致
reason.en: Whether defence results accumulate depends on comparability: sharing here, core conditions in F16

reason.zh: 把研究版图与知识更新连起来，形成有证据的研究议程
reason.en: Links the landscape to how knowledge updates, toward an evidence-based agenda

q.zh: 研究主题更新与验证方式更新是否同步？
q.en: Do evaluation methods update along with research topics?

q.zh: 研究之间有没有联系、结果能不能比较、验证依据是否来自足够不同的来源？
q.en: Are studies linked, can results be compared, and do checks come from different enough sources?

q.zh: 围绕同一个成果，引用、采用、独立采用和跨方向迁移是什么关系？
q.en: For the same work, how do citation, adoption, independent adoption and movement across directions relate?

q.zh: 开放问题与外部反例出现后，研究如何回应，主张是否修订？
q.en: After open problems and outside counter-evidence, how does research respond, and are claims revised?

standards.zh: 比例旁同时给出分子、分母、单位、时间窗和缺失。论文、实验、论文对、资源、机构和“方向 × 季度”是不同单位。未结束的半年不与完整半年直接比较；等待时间要包含尚未发生事件的对象（删失）。
standards.en: Every share comes with numerator, denominator, unit, window and missing. Papers, experiments, pairs, resources, institutions and direction-quarters are different units. Incomplete half-years are not compared with complete ones; waiting times include objects still waiting (censoring).

standards.zh: 论文对共享论文、方向季度重复观察同一方向、多个实验可能来自同一团队，不能都当独立样本。行列独立基线只描述偏离独立分布，不定义应有研究量；家族重合要与流行度条件下的基线比较。
standards.en: Pairs share papers, direction-quarters repeat directions and experiments may share teams; they are not independent samples. Independence baselines only show departures, not how much research there should be; family overlap is compared with a popularity-conditioned baseline.

standards.zh: 保留所有候选、已试口径、失败的分析和版本变化；事后选择的阈值不能称为预注册。没有差异、趋势消失、预测增益很弱的结果同样保留。
standards.en: Keep all candidates, definitions tried, failed analyses and version changes; thresholds picked afterwards are not pre-registered. No difference, vanishing trends and weak predictive gains are kept too.
